title: One Turn at the Practice Table

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: My checklist. One box. Do the turn correctly.
directions: [board: Pip stands behind a clipboard taller than Pip, with one enormous empty checkbox on it. Board unchanged.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Pay. Place. Act. Mine.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Four things. Then I am issuing three more boxes. With names.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Filed by Pip. Pay this morning's bill with this evening's payday.
directions: [board: the enormous box splits into four: PAY, PLACE, ACT, MINE]
[card: PIP'S AMENDMENTS (PENDING). One card lifts out of the drawer.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Good to see you, Pip. Overruled. This morning's bill needs crystals already in the bank.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: My promise was perfectly good. It was just facing backwards.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: First box. Pay the bills. A big piece pays a toll when our own turn starts.
directions: [board: White turn start. Bank 5. A Hono at D four. The Muju at B two. Black Sjor at I nine. The strip highlights PAY.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The Hono owes one. The Muju owes nothing. Bank five. Now bank four.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Second box. The shop. A Hi at C three costs three crystals and no actions.
directions: [board: after paying, White heals and resets its pieces. The strip highlights PLACE. A Hi appears on C three. Bank 4 to 1. No token leaves the tray of four.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Then the bank says four.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: One.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The box was right. My math needed the box.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Third box. This trip: one action.
directions: [board: the strip highlights ACT. The Hi steps from C three to C four. One token leaves the tray of four.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That trip was one square. A Hi may walk two squares for the same action.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Three actions are unused, and that is allowed. The last box is the one we count together.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The Hono. Mining one. One crystal still sitting in that square.
directions: [board: the strip highlights MINE. Three squares light up: one crystal under the Hono, three under the Muju, none under the Hi. Bank card reads two.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The Muju. Mining three. Three crystals still sitting in that square.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The new Hi. Mining one. Its square is empty.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: At our turn end, how much income arrives?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Take as long as you like. Or watch it happen with me.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Four crystals arrived.
directions: [sfx: crystal cascade] [board: one crystal, then three, then none, tumble into the bank. Bank 2 to 6. Both source squares dim to zero.]
[card: one and three and none. Four crystals. Bank one becomes bank five.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Bank one. Now bank five.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Even a new piece that moved can collect. This Hi took nothing because its square was empty.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I have ticked every box. The board declined to congratulate me.
directions: [card: EVIDENCE. Proves: the four boxes happened in order. Not checked: whether it was a good turn.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now look at tomorrow morning's bill. The Hono still owes one.
directions: [board: the strip resets to PAY. The four new crystals sit in the bank.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: So tonight's crystals can pay tomorrow's toll.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: They can. They were never allowed to pay this morning's.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Take the mission card. Play that turn twice, then meet me at the Toast Department.
directions: [card: MISSION. Play this turn twice. Change only where the new Hi stops. Write down both paydays.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The board, crystals, purchases, promotions and quiet count are public. There is no hidden build queue. If no legal purchase or promotion is available, the game skips straight to actions.

supplement.title: Everything you need to count is public
supplement.body:
Board · damage · reserves · banks · income · quiet count
No build queue or hidden production.
Place is skipped when no legal choice exists.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Tap an empty reachable square to move. Tap an enemy to preview a trip and attack, then confirm to spend the actions. Undo works inside the current turn. End Actions collects income and hands the turn over.

supplement.title: Playing your turn
supplement.body:
Empty reachable square → move
Enemy → preview movement + attack → confirm
Undo stays within this turn.
End Actions → mining → next player

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Before a new game, Black can receive an optional starting gift of one to twenty crystals. White still starts with zero. Three or more lets Black shop on its first turn. Both players still get four actions.

supplement.title: Optional Black crystal handicap
supplement.body:
Off by default. Black may start with 1–20 crystals.
At 1–2: first turn begins with actions.
At 3–20: Black can enter Place on turn 1.
Both sides always get 4 actions.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Online rooms can use a clock or be untimed. Check the chosen clock settings before starting. Running out of allowed time loses a timed game. Resigning also gives the other player the win. These video questions have no timer.

supplement.title: Choose the game’s clock before starting
supplement.body:
Online play: timed or untimed
Check the room’s chosen time settings.
Timeout or resignation gives the opponent the win.
Pause these videos whenever you like.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Pay. Place. Act. Mine.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Pay the bills first. Mine crystals last. Stopping here is fine.

question: At our turn end, how much income arrives?
